SYMMETRIC_CONVERGENCE_RULE.applies_to: Every writer of an append-only amendment to the billing authority, the entitlement authority, the CE-3 execution authority or the CE-3 manifest, whichever lands first or second: PB-A00 always; any other writer from the moment PB-A00's amendments are integrated, because PB-A00 materializes this rule, verbatim in substance, INSIDE each amendment it writes, and a rule carried by a canonical parent amendment binds every later amender of that parent.
steps: SVC-1 READ LATEST: at the writer's own base, enumerate every integrated amendment of the parent and read the LATEST canonical version as the effective parent; never write against a remembered or pre-named version.

Elements only one writer defines are additive and must not contradict the other's.
SVC-5 NO SILENT CONVERGENCE: a pre-named literal path found occupied is a STOP-and-re-derive condition for its writer, never an overwrite and never a silent rename by a third party.
